notes.title: Quick patch - v 1.0.6
notes.content:
[h2]Version 1.0.6[/h2]
- Minor shop tweaks.
- [b]Portuguese language[/b] added.
- [b]Beginner mode[/b] added. [i]Useful when you feel that Standard mode is still too hard for you.[/i]
It unlocks after a few unsuccessful attempts trying to complete the game in Standard mode. If you complete the game at least once, it will disappear.
- Some other minor menu tweaks.
